items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And I remember Deval and his sister Rhonda when they were kids.

ctx.x: And I remember Deval and his sister Rhonda when they were kids. They probably don't remember that but you know Pat used to come up to New York and visit him. Anyway, I'm kinda jumping around.
If we could go back to Pat, you said he was showing you on the piano...
